bio: Abhishek Talwar is the CTO and co-founder of Hexaview Technologies, a Noida-based custom dev firm with growing US BFSI operations in NYC. Engineering-first leader, publicly active on AI/ML content marketing. Practical, accessible — if you can show him a tool that helps Hexaview win bigger US BFSI bids, this becomes a working partnership conversation, not a vendor pitch.
